title: S2 - Reliable movement assessment
description: Weeks 3-4. Exit: camera setup, confidence handling, ROM and repetitions work for the approved exercise set; session recovery and initial accuracy evidence exist.
goal: Turn landmarks into reliable exercise measurements and recoverable sessions.
entry_criteria: Confirm owners and realistic capacity before starting.
Required predecessor deliverables are available or scheduled in dependency order.

exit_criteria.description: All sprint issues meet their acceptance criteria and completion evidence requirements.
Perform a supported exercise with live angles, counted repetitions, tracking-loss handling and saved offline results.
evidence: docs/validation/SPRINT-02-IMPLEMENTATION.md: deterministic engine and Room evidence only; physical exercise demonstration pending

demo: Perform a supported exercise with live angles, counted repetitions, tracking-loss handling and saved offline results.

Resolve early validation failures before sprint 3.

execution_plan.first_week: Work prerequisites first; review integration and measurement risks midweek.
execution_plan.second_week: Integrate, execute acceptance checks, fix defects and demonstrate the sprint outcome.
execution_plan.capacity_policy: Estimates are provisional; reserve approximately 20% of actual team capacity for integration and defects.

acceptance_criteria.description: Check required landmark visibility and selected side before enabling measurement.
Tracking loss, occlusion, multiple-person ambiguity and camera interruption produce explicit states.
Invalid frames cannot count repetitions or update valid ROM extrema.
User can recover after repositioning without a fabricated angle or repetition.

post_implementation_checks: S1/MOT-01 exercise/setup approval and MOT-05 physical phone feasibility evidence remain pending; technical gates are ready for review.
